coverage.description: Portable safety behavior required by every profile.
The selected repository Verification gates completion claims.
Agents preserve verification signals and configuration.
Active required skills have explicit work triggers.
Generated repository guidance uses the selected language.
Agents use repository sources and authoritative external documentation.
Dependency changes use the repository package manager and remain intentional.
Git and delivery actions preserve unrelated work and require explicit authority.
Secrets and environment-specific configuration stay out of generated guidance and source control.
Agents use the repository domain vocabulary and documentation layout.
Local Specs and Tasks retain their canonical ownership boundaries.
External issue triage remains deliberate and repository-aligned.
Supervisor and ACP Runtime responsibilities remain distinct.
TypeScript work uses current contracts and behavior-focused tests.
Bun owns dependency and script execution for Bun profiles.
Monorepo work respects package and bounded-context ownership.
Backend boundaries expose ownership, cancellation, and observable errors.
Frontend work follows user-visible behavior and repository-owned design policy.
Go work follows stdlib-first, context, error, and testing contracts.
Rust work uses current toolchain contracts and observable CLI tests.
CLI work treats commands and machine interfaces as public API.
TUI work keeps interaction and rendering behavior observable.
Optional Secondbrain use stays read-only, cited, and secret-safe.
